column1: 43               A Midsummer Night’s Dream           ACT 2. SC. 1
By their increase now knows not which is which.
And this same progeny of evils comes From our debate, from our dissension; We are their parents and original.
Do you amend it, then. It lies in you. Why should Titania cross her Oberon? I do but beg a little changeling boy
How long within this wood intend you stay?
